versions.summary: The first version. A bar you can click instead of filling hotbars with gearsets, and a window that lets you search and organise them.
added: A bar of job icons. One click switches. Put it where you like, then lock it so it stays there.
A library window with a search that covers names, jobs, tags and your own notes.
Favourites, your own tags, and a note per gearset.
Filters by role and category, plus incomplete sets, sets on the bar, and sets linked to a glamour plate.
Saved views, so a filter you use every week is one click rather than five.
Three levels of filter panel, from favourites only to everything, so the window can be as simple as you want it.
Warnings where two of your gearsets share a job and a name, which the game itself cannot help you with.
Text commands for everything, so it all works from a macro.
German and English, following whatever language Dalamud is set to unless you pick one.
